new-border.alt: An image with a one-cell border. Original dimensions are n by n plus seven cells.

new-ssa.alt: Two possible triangles ABC share AB of 14 centimetres, AC of 10 centimetres, and angle ABC of 35 degrees.

new-mast.alt: A vertical mast CD observed from ground points A and B, twenty metres apart, at elevations of 35 and 55 degrees.

new-bearings.alt: A route from A to B, eight kilometres on bearing 040 degrees, then six kilometres to C on bearing 100 degrees.

new-case.alt: An open rectangular case with external dimensions twelve by eight by five centimetres and walls and base 0.4 centimetres thick.

new-ducts.alt: Two similar ducts of volumes 216 and 729 cubic centimetres. The smaller duct is eight centimetres high.

new-cone.alt: A cone inside a cylinder with a common radius of 3.0 centimetres and height twelve centimetres.

new-coordinate-triangle.alt: Triangle with vertices A at negative four comma one, B at four comma five, and C at six comma one, on equally scaled coordinate axes.

new-line-regions.alt: Lines L and M meet at P above horizontal line y equals negative three. A and B are the intersections with that horizontal line, and K is directly below P.

new-arch.alt: A downward-opening parabolic arch has vertex two comma nine and passes through zero comma five.

new-tangents.alt: A circle with centre O, tangents TA and TB, point C on minor arc AB, and central angle AOB of 110 degrees.

new-vector-line.alt: Triangle OAB with C two-thirds of the way from A to B and point D beyond B on the same line. Vectors OA and OB are p and q.

vectors-trisection.alt: Triangle OAB with P and Q two-thirds along OA and OB, and R and S the midpoints of AQ and BP.

vectors-midpoint-parallelogram.alt: Parallelogram ABCD with consecutive side midpoints P, Q, R, and S joined, and diagonal AC dashed.

vectors-cevians.alt: Triangle ABC with P on BC, Q on AC, and lines AP and BQ intersecting at T.

vectors-trapezium.alt: Trapezium OABC has parallel sides OA equal to six a and CB equal to two a. Diagonals meet at X; a parallel through X meets the legs at M and N.
